newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Gemex started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Gemex started as buy.

text.p: Santander Investment said Tuesday it had started coverage of Mexican bottler Grupo Emotelladora de Mexico (Gemex) with a buy rating.
Santander analysts Alexander Robarts and Henry Garrido said they expect the company, which is PepsiCo's anchor bottler in Mexico, to report earnings of $0.52 per ADR in 1997 and $0.78 in 1998.
The analysts said they expect Gemex's soft drink volume to grow 8.8 percent in 1997 and 7.7 percent in 1998, outpacing industry performance.
Operating profits should double in 1997 and grow by 34.5 percent in 1998, they said.
Gemex was unchanged in early trade on the Mexican bourse at 13.70 pesos.
